opportunities.title: Story-first homepage hero
opportunities.description: Make the first screen clearly explain that Devil n Dove is a Southern Ontario workshop making handmade mixed-media jewelry, gifts, art experiments, and curated vintage finds.
opportunities.source_note: Google title-link guidance + Etsy shop branding/story guidance
opportunities.suggested_next_step: Rewrite hero/title/meta around handmade mixed media gifts, workshop-made pieces, and Southern Ontario relevance.

opportunities.title: Product story block on every item
opportunities.description: Add a consistent Story Behind This Piece block for materials, process, therapy/workshop context, condition, and why the piece exists.
opportunities.source_note: Etsy Seller Handbook + Baymard product page UX
opportunities.suggested_next_step: Add product editor fields for story, process notes, material notes, and care notes, then render them on product-detail pages.

opportunities.title: Media score with scale/detail/process requirements
opportunities.description: Use a visible admin checklist for main image, close-up, scale photo, back/side photo, process image/video, caption, alt text, and social share image.
opportunities.source_note: Etsy product photography guidance + Google image best practices
opportunities.suggested_next_step: Extend Product Image Health to separate required product-sale images from optional social/process images.

opportunities.title: Mobile product-finding shortcuts
opportunities.description: Give phone users short paths to Shop, Search, Cart, New Arrivals, Under $25 Gifts, Local Pickup, and One-of-a-Kind pieces.
opportunities.source_note: Baymard mobile and search UX benchmarks
opportunities.suggested_next_step: Add mobile-first quick filter chips on Shop and Collections pages.

opportunities.title: Gift-intent collections
opportunities.description: Create collections around buyer intent instead of only maker technique: under-$25 gifts, gamer/fantasy gifts, local Ontario gifts, custom gifts, vintage finds, workshop experiments.
opportunities.source_note: Ecommerce search/filter UX and local SEO relevance
opportunities.suggested_next_step: Seed collection pages and map products to gift intent tags in D1.

opportunities.title: Local pickup and Southern Ontario trust block
opportunities.description: Use repeated but natural Southern Ontario/Tillsonburg/Oxford/Norfolk wording, pickup policy, local event notes, and handmade shop proof.
opportunities.suggested_next_step: Add a reusable local trust block to footer, shop, contact, and local landing pages.

opportunities.title: Compressed mobile navigation and category groups
opportunities.description: Keep phone menus compact and expandable, while exposing key buyer tasks quickly.
opportunities.suggested_next_step: Add analytics/event tracking for mobile menu group opens and quick button taps.

opportunities.title: Marketplace-ready product exports
opportunities.description: Prepare product data for Etsy, Facebook Marketplace/Shop, Pinterest, and manual social posts without leaking private cost/order information.
opportunities.suggested_next_step: Add export-safe product feed checks for title, description, photos, price, condition, shipping, and platform notes.

opportunities.title: Crafting process social pipeline
opportunities.description: Convert job/process photos and summaries into review-first captions, scheduled posts, UTM links, and platform-specific copy.
opportunities.source_note: Build 138-141 social queue work + platform APIs
opportunities.suggested_next_step: Add privacy/do-not-post gates before job/customer media can enter the social queue.

opportunities.title: Search Console opportunity loop
opportunities.description: Use imported Search Console data to create private title/meta/internal-link actions rather than editing public pages blindly.
opportunities.suggested_next_step: Add status filters and connect SEO action completion to page metadata updates after review.

opportunities.title: Richer Product structured data readiness
opportunities.description: Improve readiness for product price, availability, shipping, return policy, images, condition, and review signals when data is present.
opportunities.suggested_next_step: Extend Structured Data Health to report missing shipping/return/image/availability signals per product.

opportunities.title: Vintage condition and provenance blocks
opportunities.description: For sourced finds, show condition, era estimate, source story, measurements, flaws, and how we cleaned/handled the item.
opportunities.suggested_next_step: Make vintage/collectible fields visible in product detail and social templates.

opportunities.title: Simple custom request intake
opportunities.description: Let visitors ask about laser engraving, personalization, ring sizing, themed gifts, or similar workshop-made pieces.
opportunities.source_note: Conversion path for small handmade shop
opportunities.suggested_next_step: Add a lightweight custom-request form with admin review queue and spam guard.

opportunities.title: Human workshop proof on About page
opportunities.description: Show the makers, process, shop reality, imperfect experiments, and why the workshop exists without overselling perfection.
opportunities.suggested_next_step: Add maker story cards, workshop photo/video slots, and process values to About.

opportunities.title: Gift bundles and add-ons
opportunities.description: Bundle earrings/cards/boxes/engraving add-ons, care cards, and small gift upsells to raise average order value.
opportunities.suggested_next_step: Add product bundle relationship table and shop bundle cards.

opportunities.title: Readable cards and accessible controls
opportunities.description: Keep text large enough, buttons tappable, panels collapsible, and forms forgiving for phone users and low-energy admin sessions.
opportunities.suggested_next_step: Add predeploy checks for tap targets, label/for pairs, and form error summaries where possible.

opportunities.title: Admin publish-readiness checklists
opportunities.description: Every draft product should show what is missing for draft, review, publish, marketplace, and social readiness.
opportunities.suggested_next_step: Connect checklist status to product table badges and bulk filters.

opportunities.title: Reviews and testimonials proof layer
opportunities.description: Collect reviews/testimonials and attach them to products, categories, local pages, and Google Business Profile activity.
opportunities.suggested_next_step: Add private testimonial intake table and admin approval workflow.

opportunities.title: Margin visibility for handmade and sourced goods
opportunities.description: Use tools/supplies/Amazon cost data to show rough product cost, fees, shipping, and margin before publishing or discounting.
opportunities.suggested_next_step: Connect product-resource usage, inventory costs, and sales price into margin-readiness cards.

opportunities.title: Market/event selling mode
opportunities.description: Support local market/event inventory, QR product cards, cash/manual payments, pickup notes, and later social recaps.
opportunities.suggested_next_step: Add event inventory list and quick sold/manual payment workflow after accounting payment application is stable.
